svg.text: Extension map — what's open, what's blocked, what's worth doing next
Green=easy(hours) · Yellow=medium(days) · Red=hard(weeks) · Dark-red border = bug worth fixing
UNFINISHED WORK
KNOWN BUGS / TECHNICAL DEBT
Sign moderation tab
160k signs, 35k unique texts. Add filter by word list (profanity / advertising) → flag list.
Data is in signs.csv already. UI tab + filter. ~2 hrs.
Player session reconstruction
spawnTimeMicros per ZDO + per-player creator_id → "when was each player active?"
Histogram per player. Identify recently-active vs ghosts. ~1 day.
Classification refresh from comfy modpack source
Re-scrape redseiko/ComfyMods + Therzie/Smoothbrain for new prefab names.
Update classification.json. Re-load on daemon restart. ~2 hrs.
Zone budget alerts (server lag detection)
Valheim's per-zone ZDO cap causes ticks-per-second drops. Bucket all ZDOs into 64m zones,
flag those over 80% of cap. ~2 days. Their MetricsBuilder has scaffolding.
Building piece census + ownership
2.6M building ZDOs (currently just counted, not stored). Detect via signature
hasCreator && (hasSupport || hasHealth). Capacity issue if all retained. ~3 days.
Cross-server snapshot comparison
Run on multiple .db files (era 13 vs 14 vs 15). Show item/player/build deltas.
Add /api/v1/snapshots + UI tab. ~4 days.
Steam ID resolution
internal_id (long) → Steam64 → display name. Needs Steam Web API key + rate-limit handling.
Cache locally. ~1 week + ongoing API cost.
Live server attach (no daemon stop)
Watch the .db file for rolling-backup writes, hot-reload chunks.
Major architecture change. ~2 weeks. Useful for live ops.
Per-player .fch parsing
Read individual character files for skills / recipes / world fog.
Requires ServerCharacters mod active. Separate file format. ~2 weeks.
lib/jetty-servlet.jar is a 554-byte stub
Blocks mvn package. Workaround: targeted javac excluding it (see build-path.svg).
Fix: download jetty-servlet-{matching-version}.jar from Maven Central. ~5 min.
cmd: curl -L -o lib/jetty-servlet.jar 'https://repo1.maven.org/...'
Boundary breach: AlertBuilder reads ZdoFlatStore
Their stated rule: only ContractBuilder touches ZdoFlatStore.
Our PA4 patch overload breaches this. Refactor: add ForensicsContract. ~half day.
v105 read path is hypothetical
Their code reads 1 byte for v≥105. We have no v105 saves to confirm.
If a v105 save appears with different layout, this will misread. Low risk.
parseInventoryIntoTotals: silent-return on safety caps
If customData has >200 keys, function returns without logging.
Could leave forensics counts incomplete on edge cases. Add log.warn. ~5 min.
Server-issuer modal renders raw HTML from crafter names
We sanitize in our standalone report.html (renderValheimText). Their SPA
uses x-html which trusts the content. Low risk (data is server-side), but XSS-shaped.
No persistent state — re-parses 1.1 GB on every start
~8 seconds. Cache ZdoFlatStore to disk after first parse, mtime-check.
~half day. Big UX win for dev loop.
Building heatmap uses count-only, not weight
A 1-stone-floor cell counts the same as a 50-stone-floor cell.
Use weighted density via per-prefab cost. ~half day.
Some Ashlands creature prefabs missing from CREATURE_NAMES
Ours catches 94k (vs theirs 89k). Both miss some — list is hand-curated.
Audit: enumerate unknown hashes with creature signature (hasMaxHealth, hasTame), add. ~2 hrs.
classification.json is hand-curated for 617 items
Modpack updates leave new items uncategorized — schedule a quarterly refresh.
